description: This file contains unit tests for the TouchMath utility class, which provides position calculations for AR navigation tools within the Unity environment. The tests validate placement calculations under various forward vector scenarios.

classes.name: TouchMath
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to compute positional placements of AR elements relative to camera orientation.

classes.name: OutdoorTouchEditModeTests
classes.description: A test fixture class containing NUnit test methods for validating the behavior of the TouchMath utility.

methods.name: TouchMath.PlaceArrowForward
methods.description: Computes a forward placement position on the ground plane based on camera position and forward vector, adjusted to avoid vertical pitch.
